criterion: Every selected validation position occurs exactly once in each model, raw predictions are finite, model/dataset/source identities match, and all eight original validation aggregates reproduce within absolute tolerance 0.0002. No model or strength promotion criterion is attached to this descriptive diagnostic.
limitations: Diagnostic only; no training, new games or playing-strength claim.
Existing validation split has been examined earlier; this is a prospectively stratified analysis of reused evidence, not untouched test data.
Value labels are terminal side-to-move outcomes, not teacher neural values. High MSE alone does not imply poor calibration.
Phase, teacher-shard, pass-target and calibration-bin summaries are descriptive; positions and shards are not independent training seeds.
Calibration error depends on the fixed bins; Brier score and outcome MSE remain separately reported.

Original bfloat16 parameters and per-device batch size are preserved, but standalone prediction compilation may change last-bit arithmetic. Aggregate reproduction is tolerance-based, not a bit-exact trajectory claim.
stopping_rule: One registered four-host attempt; retain failure and stop for mismatched selection, lineage, numerical reproduction, or timeout. No training or new games.
timeout_scope: Per-rank executable timeout; controller staging/preparation/collection is separately bounded and included in recorded attempt chip-hours.
